faq_heading: Brentwood Park condos: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Brentwood Park. No building list, strata fees, street boundaries or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Brentwood Park condos and townhomes in Burnaby: 360 listed at the end of September 2026 and 39 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. That makes Brentwood Park number 1 of 35 Burnaby communities by condo and townhome listings. Houses in Brentwood Park have their own page; this page is only about attached homes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Condo and townhome listings in Brentwood Park fell from 362 in June to 360 in September, while 198 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 27.0% of Burnaby’s 1,333 condo and townhome listings.
Condos or houses in Brentwood Park?

Brentwood Park also had 21 houses listed and 3 sold in September, against 360 condos and townhomes listed. If you are weighing a house, the Brentwood Park homes page has the detached figures and the feed for houses.

faq.q: How many condos are for sale in Brentwood Park?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 360 condos and townhomes listed in Brentwood Park. That is a month-end count and moves daily; ask Jared for what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Brentwood Park a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Brentwood Park had a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos sold in Brentwood Park from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 198 condos and townhomes sold in Brentwood Park over those 4 months, out of 750 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so any count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
